name: mirage
text:
I read the sample. It was taken before your new key reached GitHub: it still shows 'You're on the free plan' on get_games and 'Trial' on the scores sockets, and the odds socket gave no data. So I can't confirm Growth yet.

What Growth changes (from BoltOdds' pricing page):
- 1 connection, where Pro had 3. Our engine opens 2 odds sockets (lines and props), so the second would be refused.
- 3 leagues only, where Pro covered everything we select. All markets are included.

What I'll change once the key lands:
1. Read the plan from BoltOdds' own account endpoint, so the engine knows Growth vs Pro by itself.
2. On Growth, run one socket for lines and props, and never open a second.
3. Subscribe only the 3 leagues with the most +EV volume (I'll check our data rather than guess), and show the plan and chosen leagues in the engine status and the API screen.
4. Keep the Pro behavior unchanged if you ever go back.

Tell me when the key is sent, or I'll check the engine's next BoltOdds status line. If you'd rather choose the 3 leagues yourself, tell me which.
